purpose: sweep the primary solution over the budget grid under the campaign's own force statistic, so the cross-solution budget dependence is compared like with like
note: force metric only; no propagation is involved
definition: rho_force = J_force(radial)/J_force(constant), J_force being the time average of the defect magnitude
censoring_rule: a budget is censored for an orbit when the policy reaches the adopted reference degree
